description: This Java class represents a network disable join request in a mock Zigbee core testing framework. It extends a base Request class and, when executed, sends a response and disables joining on the MockZigbeeCore instance.

classes.name: NetworkDisableJoinRequest
classes.description: A request class that disables network joining in the mock Zigbee environment.

methods.name: NetworkDisableJoinRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the request with a request ID.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the request, sending a response and disabling join support.
